name: DashClaw Governance
description: Policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop approval, and decision recording for every OpenClaw tool call. Powered by DashClaw.

configSchema.description: Configure the DashClaw connection via any of three shapes: (a) canonical plugin-config keys `dashclawUrl` + `dashclawApiKey` (+ optional `agentId`); (b) SDK-style aliases `baseUrl` + `apiKey`; (c) environment variables `DASHCLAW_BASE_URL` (or legacy `DASHCLAW_URL`) + `DASHCLAW_API_KEY` (+ optional `DASHCLAW_AGENT_ID`) set before the gateway starts. Precedence is plugin config > env. No field is strictly required in this schema — env vars alone are sufficient.

dashclawUrl.description: URL of your DashClaw instance (e.g. https://my-dashclaw.vercel.app). Optional if DASHCLAW_BASE_URL / DASHCLAW_URL env var is set, or if baseUrl is provided.

dashclawApiKey.description: DashClaw API key (starts with oc_live_). Optional if DASHCLAW_API_KEY env var is set, or if apiKey is provided.

baseUrl.description: SDK-style alias for dashclawUrl. Use whichever you prefer.

apiKey.description: SDK-style alias for dashclawApiKey. Use whichever you prefer.

failClosed.description: If true, block tool calls when DashClaw is unreachable. If false, allow them to proceed.

riskScoreDefault.description: Default risk score for tool calls that don't have a specific mapping

highRiskTools.description: Tool names that should always get risk_score 80+ (e.g. bash, exec, deploy)
